:::{#hero-heading}

Hello! I'm a PhD candidate in [DECOD lab](https://www.umr-decod.fr/en) at Rennes in France.

My work sits at the intersection of evolutionary genetics, population genomics, and conservation biology — with Atlantic salmon (*Salmo salar*) as a model.

Outside the lab, you'll find me doing mostly sports: running 🏃 , going to the gym 🏋️, diving/snorkeling 🤿, hiking with a bivouac ⛺, or playing padel.🥎 

Feel free to reach out at [emilio.egal@inrae.fr](mailto:emilio.egal@inrae.fr)
:::
